prompt: Option help and error messages are wrong when an option's `envvar` is a sequence of names or empty. With `show_envvar=True`: an empty `envvar` (`[]`, `""`) must render exactly like no `envvar` (so with `auto_envvar_prefix="WEATHER"` an option `--units` shows `[env var: WEATHER_UNITS]`, and without a prefix shows no env var part). In the missing-required-option error hint, the env vars must be listed like `'--units' (env var: 'WEATHER_UNITS', 'UNITS')` for a list or tuple, `'--units' (env var: 'UNITS')` for a single name, and just `'--units'` when `envvar` is empty.

Add a `context_settings` parameter to `CliRunner.invoke` in click's testing module. It is passed through to the context that the invoked command creates (the same settings a command accepts via `context_settings=`), so tests can, for example, invoke with `context_settings={"color": True}`. When `invoke` is not given an explicit `color` argument, ANSI styling in the captured output (including output from `echo_via_pager`, `prompt` and `confirm`) must follow the context's color setting.
accept: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_termui.py tests/test_testing.py

prompt: Help pages break lines inside hyphenated words, e.g. `--avoid-motorways` can be split after a hyphen. Change click's help text wrapping so that a line only ever breaks between whitespace-separated words, never after a hyphen inside a word; a word longer than the available width is not cut but placed on a line of its own; ANSI escape sequences (styled text, including in the initial indent) do not count toward the width and every escape sequence survives in order; and the `Usage:` prefix does not push a short argument list like `[OPTIONS] CITY` onto a second line.

prompt: Add a positional-argument validator `NoDuplicateArgs` to cobra, usable like `ExactArgs`/`MinimumNArgs` as a command's `Args`. It rejects repeated arguments with the error message `duplicate argument "<arg>" for "<command name>"` (for example `duplicate argument "one" for "c"`), accepts distinct arguments, and works together with commands that also define `ValidArgs` (for example when combined via `MatchAll`).

When a program has no sub-commands its root command can accept positional arguments, but cobra adds the default `completion` command anyway, which turns the root into a command with a sub-command so it no longer accepts arguments. Change cobra so that for a root command without other sub-commands the default `completion` command is only added when it is actually being invoked (`prog completion ...`) or when it is itself being completed; programs that do have sub-commands keep the current behaviour.

Allow customising the default ShellCompDirective that cobra uses when no completion function provides one (today it is always `ShellCompDirectiveDefault`). Add `func (c *CompletionOptions) SetDefaultShellCompDirective(d ShellCompDirective)`. The setting applies to the command and is inherited by its sub-commands from the nearest ancestor that set it; a sub-command can reset it by setting `ShellCompDirectiveDefault`. It must affect flag-value and argument completion.

Add a new FAQ page at /<locale>/<design>/faq with its own title and at least three question-and-answer items, with the text in all three languages (English, Arabic, Kurdish Sorani), and link it from the site header navigation.
